services.value: Provides environmental testing services for air and vapor, built environment testing, general environment services, including ground and surface water, industrial hygiene, metals and metals speciation, microplastics, municipal and drinking water, PFAS testing, sediment and tissue, soil and hazardous waste, and specialty services. Also supports waste management clients with analytical options including groundwater and leachate monitoring, landfill gas monitoring, ambient air monitoring, waste characterization, and RCRA characteristic testing (ignitability, corrosivity, reactivity and toxicity) including TCLP, SPLP and CA WET methods.
